steps.text: Talk to Eye of Argos – accept the quest

why: the nearest gatekeeper landing on foot (Goddard -> Wall of Argos) is a 31.8k walk — more than the 25k walk limit
walk not on the geodata from 165054,-47861 (gave up after 2000001 cells (too far or no way))
